title: Fine-tune plugin working in one instance but not the other
description: Two identical instances (inst234 and inst567) have the same fine-tune plugin version setup, but the feature is working in inst234 and failing in inst567. Both instances appear to have identical configuration for the required fine-tune plugin version.

logs: inst234: fine-tune plugin v2.1.4 initialized successfully
inst567: fine-tune plugin v2.1.4 initialization attempted but plugin not responding
inst567: plugin service health check: UNHEALTHY
inst234: plugin service health check: HEALTHY
inst567: log shows 'unable to connect to fine-tune backend service on port 8443'
inst234: fine-tune requests completing normally with inference latency 250ms
inst567: fine-tune requests timing out after 30s
affected_queries: Model prediction requests using fine-tuned models

team_suspicion: plugin configuration or backend service connectivity issue

network_connectivity.evidence: Network connectivity confirmed working between inst567 and backend service.

root_cause.cause: prepare() method was customized/overridden in inst567
root_cause.issue: Instance-level code customization diverged from out-of-box (OOB) implementation
root_cause.fix_applied: Reverted prepare() method to OOB version
root_cause.result: Plugin initialized successfully, inference requests completing normally

lesson_learned: Config parity is necessary but not sufficient - must also validate code-level implementation matches across instances
